core_obligations: Quote the implication from flatness to torsion freeness from the preceding statement (proof lines 4930-4931).
Invoke the equational criterion of flatness to reduce the converse to showing that every relation is trivial (proof lines 4932-4936).

Renumber the terms of a relation so that the first coefficient has minimal valuation, factor the other coefficients through it and use torsion freeness to solve for the first element (proof lines 4936-4944).
Exhibit the coefficients making the relation a combination of trivial relations, so that the criterion applies (proof lines 4944-4950).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to triviality of relations (proof lines 4932-4936).
Use the valuation to factor the coefficients (proof lines 4936-4944).
Write the trivial relation and conclude (proof lines 4944-4951).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the converse companion of the earlier statement that flat modules are torsion free, restricted to valuation rings, and the proof is a 22-line argument with the equational criterion. After quoting the easy direction it assumes the module torsion free and takes an arbitrary relation; renumbering so that one coefficient has minimal valuation it factors all the coefficients through that one, uses torsion freeness to solve for one of the elements, and then exhibits the trivial relations that make the original relation trivial, with the matrix entries written out explicitly. The renumbering and the explicit trivial relation are the substance, and both are displayed.
